pre_execution_scope_amendment: User explicitly requested USD straight pairs; expanded five to nine symbols BEFORE ANY OUTCOMES, profitable-pair threshold rounded up from 60% to 6/9
entry_rules: Pine preparation/cancellation preserved; strict confirmed directional gates; next available open even across gaps; no exit-bar reuse

exit_rules.reward_risk_ratio: user-specific moving SMA20 full exit, not fixed RR
exit_rules.target_update: after current bar fills, next bar uses newly confirmed SMA

period_semantics: start inclusive end exclusive; independent flat period portfolios, pre-period warmup; continuous full period also saved
evaluation_access: All candidates training only; selected candidate plus baseline only access validation/final/continuous. If no selected candidate, baseline alone is descriptive after training.

mode_definitions.2: mode0 and buy close>previous high / sell close<previous low
mode_definitions.3: mode0 and buy close>preparation high / sell close<preparation low

distance_rule: side*(current SMA-current close)/pip >= multiple*cost; no entry-fill lookahead

cost_and_fill_model.deduction: once at settlement, all raw OHLC fills
cost_and_fill_model.commission: zero metadata only; abort if nonzero
cost_and_fill_model.intrabar: SL first if optional stop; default none

position_sizing_and_currency: one fixed-unit position per symbol, no pyramiding; pips not account currency
selection: Rank nonbaseline candidates using training only: both cost cases net>0, net+open>0, trades>=40, >=6/9 profitable pairs. Rank by minimum training net across cost cases descending then id ascending. Select at most one; validation/final cannot trigger fallback candidate or retuning.
acceptance_gates: Selected candidate: each independent period net>0 and net+open>0; continuous full period net>0 and net+open>0, >=100 closed trades, >=6/9 positive pairs; final >=30 closed trades, >=6/9 positive pairs. All gates in BOTH cost cases. Baseline is descriptive not automatically adopted.
cross_symbol_rule: same candidate on all nine symbols; no profitable-symbol postselection; mixed quote-currency pips aggregate is an equal-pip research score NOT account profit
code_identifier: script and protocol SHA256 saved by runner before first data load
stop_rule: no train-eligible candidate or any validation/final gate failure => REJECTED, no further search in this experiment
